messages:
oliver: kicked off a cross-region snapshot restore for tenant-77 and hit KMS decrypt failures on a subset of objects after transfer completed
oliver: error: `AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/aa11`
meera: curious if this is a key-policy vs grant problem. cross-region copies often use a different principal when assuming the uploader role
jon: pulling CloudTrail 126-03-20T08:03:12Z CreateGrant shows ok for the staging region, but 08:11:40Z shows `Encrypt` attempts from `arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/cross-region-copy@accountB` failing
infra-bot: note: recent key policy change (PR 703) added a Condition requiring `aws:PrincipalOrgID` == "o-abc123" to limit use to our org. That blocks cross-account copy roles that don't carry the OrgID attribute
oliver: that would explain it: cross-region-copy assumes a role in the partner account during transfer and loses the OrgID claim so KMS denies encrypt/decrypt
meera: mitigation options: 1) add explicit Allow for the cross-region-copy role ARNs 2) remove the OrgID condition 3) change transfer to use our account-side proxy that retains OrgID
jon: quick patch applied: added a narrow policy statement allowing `arn:aws:sts::456:assumed-role/cross-region-copy` kms:Encrypt and kms:Decrypt on the key and re-run restore test
oliver: patched and re-run, final blobs decrypted ok. checksums matched :white_check_mark:
meera: audit query I used: `fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, errorMessage | filter eventName in ["Encrypt","Decrypt"] and requestParameters.keyId = "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/aa11"`
jon: follow-ups: 1) add a CI gate: PRs that add `aws:PrincipalOrgID` condition must include a cross-account test matrix or an explicit exception list 2) add telemetry: when KMS denies due to missing OrgID, emit metric `kms.orgid_denied` with key and role for rapid triage
oncall-sre: also recommend we add a pre-copy validation that simulates `kms:Encrypt` using the copy principal before starting long-running multi-GB transfers
meera: long-term design: prefer proxy-transfer pattern so the copy occurs under our account principal that retains OrgID, reduces key-policy complexity for cross-account snapshots
jon: postmortem items: update key-policy authoring docs, add test harness for OrgID conditions, scan all CMKs for `aws:PrincipalOrgID` conditions and list affected cross-account roles. I'll open tickets
sec-bot: Incident recorded (id=sec-2026-03-21-14). Reminder: attach CloudTrail snippets, modified key-policy diff, and S3 object manifests to the ticket for audit retention
oliver: leaving this thread open 72h for any late evidence. tagging @oncall-sre for monitoring replay
